posts.text: Serving Mother India for such a long time has been possible only with God's grace and the unwavering trust of 140 crore Indians. Thank you for your love and support. Together, we will build a Viksit Bharat.

posts.text: In today's interconnected world, prosperity and challenges are shared, but the consequences of conflicts and uncertainty fall disproportionately on developing countries and the Global South. We must work together for equitable growth.

posts.text: I'll be leaving my role at the White House at the end of this month. It is hard to express how big a privilege it has been to serve the American people. Without President Trump's leadership, we would not be leading in the AI race.

posts.text: One plus one must be equal to three — that's what we're trying to do at the World Bank. In development, delay is equal to denial. We must deliver results faster for the people who need them most.

posts.text: At the Global Convergence for Growth Summit, we reaffirmed that multilateral cooperation is the only path to shared prosperity. France stands ready to lead on climate, trade, and development.

posts.text: Dubai continues to lead by example in innovation, infrastructure, and global connectivity. Our vision is to make the UAE the world's most future-ready nation.
posts.caption: Dubai continues to lead by example in innovation, infrastructure, and global connectivity. Our vision is to make the UAE the world's most future-ready nation.

posts.text: I love the incredible people of SpaceX beyond words. Nothing else matters if civilization falls. Today we take SpaceX public — building the future of humanity among the stars.
posts.caption: I love the incredible people of SpaceX beyond words. Nothing else matters if civilization falls. Today we take SpaceX public — building the future of humanity among the stars.

posts.text: Given the complexity of these changes, we've made mistakes and will almost certainly make more. But the AI transformation of Meta is the most important work we've ever done. We're all in.
posts.caption: Given the complexity of these changes, we've made mistakes and will almost certainly make more. But the AI transformation of Meta is the most important work we've ever done. We're all in.

posts.text: AI is the most profound platform shift of our lifetimes. At Google, we're making it helpful and accessible for everyone. Excited to speak at Stanford's commencement — the next generation will shape this technology.
posts.caption: AI is the most profound platform shift of our lifetimes. At Google, we're making it helpful and accessible for everyone. Excited to speak at Stanford's commencement — the next generation will shape this technology.

posts.text: Everyone is a stakeholder in AI — that's why we've launched a company-wide AI governance framework. Don't default to the most powerful model for every task. Match the model to the job. We have to turn Xbox into a sustainable business too.
posts.caption: Everyone is a stakeholder in AI — that's why we've launched a company-wide AI governance framework. Don't default to the most powerful model for every task. Match the model to the job. We have to turn Xbox into a sustainable business too.

posts.text: We were pretty wrong about the social and economic implications of AI, especially regarding jobs. OpenAI is preparing for its IPO — we've filed confidentially with the SEC. The future is coming faster than anyone expected.

posts.text: WWDC 2026 was special — my final one leading the keynote. I'm proud to hand the reins to John Ternus on September 1. Apple's best days are ahead, with AI woven into everything we build.

posts.text: The narrative that connects AI to job loss for many CEOs is just too lazy. How is it possible that AI became productive only six months ago and they were laying people off two years ago because of AI? AI demand is insanely strong.

posts.text: India's digital public infrastructure — Aadhaar, UPI, ONDC — is a model for the world. We must now build AI infrastructure that is open, inclusive, and serves a billion people.

posts.text: AI will be the most transformative technology since the internet. But we need to ensure its benefits reach everyone, especially in global health and education. That's where I'm focused.

posts.text: At IBM, we're helping enterprises deploy AI that is trusted, transparent, and delivers real business value. The agentic AI era is here — it's about augmenting human capability, not replacing it.

posts.text: At Chanel, we're proving that heritage and innovation can coexist beautifully. Leading with purpose and empowering our teams globally — that's how we build enduring brands for the future.

posts.text: At FedEx, we're leveraging AI and data to transform global logistics. The future of commerce is intelligent, connected, and faster than ever. We're building the supply chain of tomorrow, today.

posts.text: From an opponent to a friend over the years. It's been a pleasure watching you bat and compete against you over so many years, Kane. But more than that, I value our friendship and shared perspectives on the game and beyond.

posts.text: Cricket has given me everything. Leading India is the greatest honor. We're building a team culture that's about collective excellence — every player knows their role and delivers when it matters.

posts.text: Cricket taught me patience, leadership, and the value of staying calm under pressure. The game goes on, and the memories we've created together will last forever. Thank you for the love.

posts.text: Hard work and discipline — there are no shortcuts in cricket or in life. Every delivery is an opportunity. I'm grateful for the support and focused on getting better every day.

posts.text: What a season it's been! All-round cricket is about being ready for every challenge. Grateful for the opportunities and focused on giving my best for India in every format.

posts.text: Cricket is a beautiful game that teaches you about life — patience, perseverance, and teamwork. Watching the next generation carry the torch fills me with pride. Keep chasing your dreams!
